title: Key Apple products, including Apple Watch, AirPods and Mac Mini, dodge China tariffs
text: Key Apple products, including Apple Watch, AirPods and Mac Mini, dodge China tariffs Tuesday, 18 September 2018 ( 38 minutes ago ) Apple avoided feared tariffs from China on popular products like its Apple Watch and AirPods after the U.S. opted to exclude the products. President Trump announced a 10 percent tariff on some $200 billion of Chinese imports on Monday.
